source_title: Square Enix Officially Announces New Final Fantasy 10 25th Anniversary Release - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Final Fantasy 10 is celebrating its 25th anniversary in 2026, and Square Enix has been giving fans plenty of reasons to revisit one of the franchise's most beloved entries. Originally released for the PS2 in 2001, the RPG introduced players to Spira, the threat of Sin, and the unforgettable journey of Tidus and Yuna. Even 25 years later, Final Fantasy 10 remains a favorite among longtime fans, particularly because of its emotional storytelling, memorable characters, and iconic romance.
The anniversary has also brought renewed attention to the future of Final Fantasy 10 , with fans continuing to hope that Square Enix will eventually revisit Spira with a Final Fantasy 10 remake or another new project . Nothing of the sort has been officially announced, but the company has been celebrating the game's legacy through special releases and collaborations. Tidus and Yuna have understandably remained central to those celebrations, and the latest Final Fantasy 10 announcement gives both characters something particularly special (and extremely limited).
Final Fantasy 10 25th Anniversary Release Celebrates Tidus and Yuna
Square Enix and watchmaker Tendence have revealed two limited-edition Final Fantasy 10 watches inspired by Tidus and Yuna , with just 200 of each being produced worldwide. Both are part of Tendence's De'Color collection, featuring gradients that extend across the watch faces, cases, and straps. Pre-orders opened on October 20, ahead of an official November 20 release. Japanese retailer Hobby Genki has also listed both models, with the Tidus edition priced at 78,550 Yen and Yuna's at 62,550 Yen. The official Japanese prices are 69,300 Yen (approximately $450) and 53,900 Yen (approximately $350), respectively.

The Tidus watch is particularly striking, featuring an ice-blue and white gradient inspired by the oceans and skies of Spira. Its hour hand is modeled after Tidus' Brotherhood sword, while the minute hand takes inspiration from his ultimate weapon, Caladbolg. The second hand features a FF10 Blitzball design , and the center of the face displays the Zanarkand Abes emblem. It's also the larger of the two Final Fantasy 10 watches, measuring approximately 50mm across. The aluminum case, silicone strap, and quartz movement round out the design, which incorporates several references to Tidus without simply putting his character artwork on the face.
Yuna's watch takes a different approach, using a softer combination of pink, yellow, and blue to represent the beloved Final Fantasy 10 summoner . Its hour and minute hands are inspired by the Nirvana and Magistral Rod, respectively, while the center features the floral ornament from Yuna's outfit. The pearlescent face also changes its appearance depending on the viewing angle, adding another distinctive touch.
Between the limited production numbers and the significance of Final Fantasy 10 's 25th anniversary , these are clearly aimed at dedicated collectors. It's also a fitting celebration of Tidus and Yuna, whose story remains one of the biggest reasons Final Fantasy 10 continues to resonate with fans.
